template: A floor mosaic in the style of the floor of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan: polished marble tesserae, freshly laid, seen straight from above, matte, no bevel, no gloss, no drop shadow, flat like the reference cartouche, not a 3D render and not a photo. A wide rectangular panel filling the whole frame edge to edge: a cream ivory ground laid in neat rows, with delicate slate-blue and ochre scrollwork and leaf-green acanthus sprigs in the four corners. In the middle, laid in the same small tesserae: {scene} Vespi is the character from the reference images: a small round white figure with a red helmet with one white stripe down the middle, two small round black dot eyes, rosy cheeks, a small closed smile and a leaf-green scarf; keep his face exactly that simple, eyes always open. Keep all figures and objects inside the central two thirds of the panel, with calm empty ground around them. Palette: cream ivory, warm ochre, terracotta red, slate blue, leaf green, a little brass. No text, no letters, no numbers, no people.

items.scene: Vespi leans over a long unrolled document with a red wax seal and studies it through a big round brass magnifying glass; behind the glass one of his dot eyes looks comically huge. A wooden rubber stamp and an ink pad lie beside him, and a pigeon at the other end of the document peers at it too, head tilted.

Then, on a bright rendered terrace scene: «нет, другую иллюстрацию в другом, более таком реалисте… Вернись к этому стилю, который был раньше, который типа все иллюстрации, которые на сайте… сделай в таком же стиле».

items.prompt: Editorial travel photograph, 35mm, photorealistic, in the same photographic style, light and natural muted colours as the last reference image: a stone rooftop terrace in Florence at golden hour, a weathered balustrade, terracotta pots with a lemon tree and rosemary, the Duomo and terracotta rooftops softly out of focus beyond, a wide pale warm sky. The exact same handmade cotton toy character as in the references (smooth cream cotton body with fine fibres, a large satin red helmet with a cream stripe and a small olive side button, as wide as his body, tiny round open black dot eyes, a tiny smile, pink cheeks, short stubby arms and legs with mitten paws, olive green felt collar with a red button) stands on the terrace floor on tiptoe and launches a folded white paper plane with one raised paw; four more real paper planes glide away over the rooftops at the right, slightly motion-blurred, two swallows swoop past; a stack of blank paper on a small iron table lifts in the breeze. He is in the lower middle of the frame, in the bottom third, small in the scene, clearly a soft toy placed in the real place; the upper middle of the frame is calm open sky. Real stone textures, shallow depth of field, not an illustration, not a 3D render, no oversaturation. No text, no signs, no flags, no people, no logos.
items.review: At full size: the helmet with its stripe and olive button, two open dot eyes, the small smile, pink cheeks, the felt collar with the red button and the small round body match the references; no people, letters, signs, flags or logos. Not upscaled (the upscaler turns the cotton into plastic: landscape-2026-11-21-amalfi-still.json).
items.retouch: Painted out into the sky: two swallows that flew where the heading stands, and the paper plane that touched the end of the paragraph.
items.frame: The 2688×1520 original cut to the tile's 1.84:1 (59 px of floor off the bottom): the helmet's top at 49% of the height. webp q82 at 960, 1200, 1920, 2560. Phones: the square around Vespi, 780 and 1170 (a phone is sent 1200px at most).

processing: 2048x1360 PNG; 50 px cut from every edge (the outer border line, which the tile's rounded corners would have cut unevenly), 1948x1260; master WebP q90; site WebP q72 at 640, 1024, 1200 and 1600 px. q72 because the tesserae are fine detail: 1200 px is 229 KB (q80 284 KB; a median filter halved it but blurred the joints between stones). Lazy, below the cabinet's first screen.
